entities.name: Electorate of India
entities.description: The body of citizens registered on India's electoral rolls. They directly elect the Lok Sabha (and State Legislative Assemblies) under Article 326 universal adult suffrage, and indirectly elect the President and Vice-President through their elected representatives.
entities.legalBasis: Article 326, Constitution of India (universal adult suffrage)

entities.name: Constitution of India
entities.description: The supreme law of India. Adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 26 November 1949 and in force from 26 January 1950, it creates and limits the powers of the Union and State governments, the fundamental rights of citizens, and every entity mapped in this graph.
entities.legalBasis: Adopted by the Constituent Assembly of India

entities.name: Government of India
entities.description: The executive branch of the Union of India, headed nominally by the President and in practice by the Prime Minister and Union Council of Ministers, who administer the ministries, departments, agencies, armed forces and public-sector undertakings of the Union.
entities.legalBasis: Part V, Constitution of India (The Union)

entities.name: President's Secretariat
entities.description: The office that assists the President of India in discharging constitutional, ceremonial and administrative duties, and manages Rashtrapati Bhavan.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Vice-President's Secretariat
entities.description: The office that assists the Vice-President of India in discharging duties as ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha and other constitutional functions.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Prime Minister's Office
entities.description: The Prime Minister's own secretariat: it coordinates policy across ministries, handles PM's day-to-day work, foreign-policy and security files, and monitors flagship programmes. Headed by one or more Principal Secretaries to the PM, with Advisers, Additional Secretaries and Joint Secretaries.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Cabinet Secretariat
entities.description: The apex coordinating department of the Union executive. It gives secretarial assistance to the Union Cabinet and its committees, resolves inter-ministerial differences, and administratively oversees several security and intelligence bodies including R&AW.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Transaction of Business) Rules, 1961 and (Allocation of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: National Security Council
entities.description: India's apex body for national security and strategic policy, chaired by the Prime Minister. Its three tiers are the Strategic Policy Group, the National Security Advisory Board, and the National Security Council Secretariat.
entities.legalBasis: Executive order, established 19 November 1998

entities.name: National Security Council Secretariat
entities.description: The secretariat of the National Security Council, headed by the National Security Advisor; it runs strategic-planning, internal-affairs, intelligence-and-technology and military verticals, and coordinates the Joint Intelligence Committee.
entities.legalBasis: Executive order, 1998

entities.name: National Security Advisory Board
entities.description: An external panel of retired officials, military officers and academics that gives the NSC long-term threat assessments and policy recommendations. Reconstituted April 2025 with 7 members.
entities.legalBasis: Executive order under the National Security Council

entities.name: Research and Analysis Wing
entities.description: India's primary foreign-intelligence agency, responsible for external intelligence gathering, counter-terrorism abroad and covert operations. Headed by the Secretary (R), it reports through the Cabinet Secretariat directly to the Prime Minister, and is administratively outside the RTI Act.
entities.legalBasis: Executive order, 1968 (not a statutory body)

entities.name: National Technical Research Organisation
entities.description: India's technical-intelligence agency, handling SIGINT, remote sensing, cyber security and cryptology for the security establishment. Set up on the recommendation of the Cabinet Committee on Security; reports to the NSA and PMO.
entities.legalBasis: Cabinet Committee on Security approval, October 2004

entities.name: NITI Aayog
entities.description: The Union Government's premier public-policy think tank, which replaced the Planning Commission in 2015. It advises the Centre and States on policy and monitors flagship programmes; the Prime Minister chairs it ex officio, with a full-time Vice-Chairperson, full-time members, a CEO, and a Governing Council of all State/UT Chief Ministers.
entities.legalBasis: Cabinet Resolution, 1 January 2015

entities.name: Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister
entities.description: A non-constitutional, non-statutory, non-permanent body of economists that advises the Prime Minister on economic and related issues; it is reconstituted after every general election. NITI Aayog provides its administrative/secretarial support.
entities.legalBasis: Executive order, reconstituted periodically

entities.name: Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser to the Government of India
entities.description: Advises the Prime Minister and Union Government on science, technology and innovation policy, and coordinates cross-departmental S&T missions.
entities.legalBasis: Executive order, 1999

entities.name: Appointments Committee of the Cabinet
entities.description: Decides all senior civil-service, defence, public-sector and constitutional-body appointments; effectively the Centre's top appointing authority.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Transaction of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Cabinet Committee on Security
entities.description: The final decision-making body on defence, internal security and major national-security matters; the NSA, Cabinet Secretary and the Defence/Home/External Affairs Secretaries are permanent invitees.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Transaction of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Cabinet Committee on Political Affairs
entities.description: Deliberates on politically sensitive policy and administrative issues that cut across ministries.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Transaction of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs
entities.description: Reviews economic trends and approves major investment, pricing and economic-policy proposals above delegated financial limits.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Transaction of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Cabinet Committee on Parliamentary Affairs
entities.description: Oversees Government business in Parliament, including the legislative agenda for each session.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Transaction of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Cabinet Committee on Accommodation
entities.description: Allots government accommodation to ministers, MPs and senior officials.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Transaction of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Cabinet Committee on Investment and Growth
entities.description: Fast-tracks large public and private investment proposals and infrastructure projects that are stuck for want of clearances.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Transaction of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Cabinet Committee on Employment and Skill Development
entities.description: Coordinates employment-generation and skilling schemes across ministries.
entities.legalBasis: Government of India (Transaction of Business) Rules, 1961

entities.name: Union Council of Ministers
entities.description: All ministers of the Union — Cabinet Ministers, Ministers of State (Independent Charge) and Ministers of State — appointed by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister. Collectively responsible to the Lok Sabha.
entities.legalBasis: Article 74 and Article 75, Constitution of India

entities.name: Union Cabinet
entities.description: The inner, senior tier of the Union Council of Ministers — Cabinet Ministers only — which is the de facto chief decision-making body of the Union executive and the body whose committees (see Cabinet Committees) transact most government business.
entities.legalBasis: Constitutional convention; Article 74

entities.name: Inter-State Council
entities.description: A recommendatory (non-statutory, non-permanent) body set up under Article 263 to investigate and discuss subjects of common interest between the Union and States, or among States. Chaired by the Prime Minister; members are all State Chief Ministers, Chief Ministers/Administrators of UTs, Governors of States under President's Rule, and 6 Union Cabinet Ministers nominated by the PM. Its Standing Committee is chaired by the Union Home Minister.
entities.legalBasis: Article 263, Constitution of India; Presidential Order of 28 May 1990

entities.name: Northern Zonal Council
entities.description: Statutory advisory body under Part III of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 for coordination among member States/UTs: Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Rajasthan, and the UTs of Chandigarh, Delhi, Jammu & Kashmir, Ladakh. Chaired by the Union Home Minister; member States' Chief Ministers serve as Vice-Chairman on an annual rotating basis.
entities.legalBasis: States Reorganisation Act, 1956, Part III

entities.name: Central Zonal Council
entities.description: Statutory advisory body under Part III of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 for coordination among member States/UTs: Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand. Chaired by the Union Home Minister; member States' Chief Ministers serve as Vice-Chairman on an annual rotating basis.
entities.legalBasis: States Reorganisation Act, 1956, Part III

entities.name: Eastern Zonal Council
entities.description: Statutory advisory body under Part III of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 for coordination among member States/UTs: Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, West Bengal. Chaired by the Union Home Minister; member States' Chief Ministers serve as Vice-Chairman on an annual rotating basis.
entities.legalBasis: States Reorganisation Act, 1956, Part III

entities.name: Western Zonal Council
entities.description: Statutory advisory body under Part III of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 for coordination among member States/UTs: Goa, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and the UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. Chaired by the Union Home Minister; member States' Chief Ministers serve as Vice-Chairman on an annual rotating basis.
entities.legalBasis: States Reorganisation Act, 1956, Part III

entities.name: Southern Zonal Council
entities.description: Statutory advisory body under Part III of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 for coordination among member States/UTs: Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, and (as special invitees) the UTs of Puducherry, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep. Chaired by the Union Home Minister; member States' Chief Ministers serve as Vice-Chairman on an annual rotating basis.
entities.legalBasis: States Reorganisation Act, 1956, Part III

entities.name: North Eastern Council
entities.description: Statutory regional planning and advisory body for the 8 North-Eastern states (Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura, Sikkim since 2002); it functions under the Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (DoNER).
entities.legalBasis: North Eastern Council Act, 1971
